definitions:
Whether the raw tokens the wellness predictor reads carry the differences in realised bodily wellness between the
candidate commands of one decision: the information-flow gate (the style guide training preflight, gate 1) of the repair named
in WELLNESS_GOAL_ATTAINMENT_2026-10-06.md section 4. A ridge readout is trained across bodies from the raw tokens of
vision, tactile, audio and proprioception at the hold's last model step to the realised bodily mean at that model step,
and judged by pairs in 100 on held-out bodies. Arithmetic on the saved rows and token files of row
investigate_wellness_goal_attainment_481800; no model is built or loaded, nothing is executed.

    PY token_information.py --run D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/wellness_attain_runs/goal_attainment_481800
                            --out D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/wellness_attain_runs/token_information_481800
    PY token_information.py --selftest --out <folder>     (synthetic data only: the pipeline's own check)

Registry row: investigate_token_information_bodily_481800. Record:
docs/gain_of_function_v4/coordinator/WELLNESS_GOAL_ATTAINMENT_2026-10-06.md.

INPUTS (read only)
  rows.jsonl: per decision and candidate command, the grounded terms tactile_comfort, capability and motor_state at
    the hold's last model step (executed[c][4].terms) and the wellness predictor's 5 outputs on the actual raw tokens of
    that model step with the live motor token (executed[c][4].judge_actual);
  worker_*/tokens_<body>_<k>.npz: raw_end_<c>_<sense>, the raw (encoder output, before the top-down gate) tokens of the
    same model step, 192 numbers per sense, for vision, tactile, audio, proprioception and vestibular. The motor token
    of that model step was not saved.
DEFINITIONS
  target y      the realised bodily mean at the hold's last model step, (tactile_comfort + capability + motor_state) / 3,
                each grounded term 0 to 1;
  features X    the 4 tokens the wellness predictor reads beside the motor token: vision, tactile, audio, proprioception
                (768 numbers);
  centring      X and y minus their means over the decision's 11 candidates: what is left is the difference between
                the commands from one state;
  readout       ridge regression on the centred items without intercept; each feature divided by its standard deviation
                over the training items (features under 1e-8 left out); penalty LAMBDA x (number of training items),
                LAMBDA from LAMBDAS, picked by the smallest summed squared error when each training body in turn is
                left out; trained on 7 bodies, applied to the 8th, each body held out once;
  pairs in 100  mimo_bridge/tools/command_ranking.ranking over the held-out readouts: of all pairs of one decision's
                candidates, how many the readout orders as the realised value orders them (a pair whose realised values
                differ by no more than 1 in 100 of that decision's spread is left out); 50 = chance, 100 = every pair;
                95% interval from resampling whole bodies;
  held-out R2   1 - (summed squared error of the held-out readouts) / (summed square of the centred y): 0 = the readout
                carries none of the differences, 1 = all of them, below 0 = worse than predicting no difference;
  control       the same pipeline with y shuffled among each decision's candidates, PERMUTATIONS times (seeded);
  reference     the wellness predictor's own bodily mean (outputs 1, 2, 4) on the same raw tokens with the live motor
                token, against the same y.
VERDICT
  pass     the readout's pairs in 100 has the lower end of its 95% interval above 50;
  fail     it does not;
  invalid  fewer than 48 decisions or 6 bodies, or the control's mean pairs in 100 outside 45 to 55.
